themes.evidence: Create and maintain feature pipelines, feature stores, and model stores.
Drive end-to-end development of AI infrastructure and AI-driven applications — from proof-of-concept to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.
Build critical infrastructure and tooling that leverages AI/ML to enhance productivity, efficiency.
Implement automated systems for continuous training, validation, and monitoring of models, minimizing downtime and ensuring reliability.
Experience with LLMs including RAG and fine-tuning techniques.
Collaborate with technologists, traders, quantitative researchers, and data scientists to identify high-impact opportunities.

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is building AI/ML infrastructure: feature pipelines, feature/model stores, MLOps/AIOps tooling, continuous training/validation/monitoring, and GPU/CPU optimization — production ML engineering, not client-facing delivery or analytics.
notes: Quant trading firm context; heavy MLOps/AIOps + compute-infra emphasis (TensorRT/ONNX, GPU optimization) signals model-serving/infra depth beyond generic ML. LLM/RAG is listed but secondary to the infrastructure mandate.
